LESSON: GOOD BEHAVIOUR DURING MEALTIMES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.5: Good behaviour during mealtimes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Good behaviour during mealtimes. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: why it is important to mealtimes?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words
2. give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home
3. practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone
4. apply Good behaviour during mealtimes in a real Kenyan situation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GOOD BEHAVIOUR DURING MEALTIMES
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Good behaviour during mealtimes helps you succeed in HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

PART 1: Explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Good behaviour during mealtimes” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home

What this means
In this part you learn to give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Good behaviour during mealtimes matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Apply: Describe one safe action you can take related to Good behaviour during mealtimes this week.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Good behaviour during mealtimes in a real Kenyan situation

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Good behaviour during mealtimes in a real Kenyan situation. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Good behaviour during mealtimes in a real Kenyan situation.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Good behaviour during mealtimes” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Good behaviour during mealtimes in a real Kenyan situation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Good behaviour during mealtimes is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Good behaviour during mealtimes” around your school. (skill: explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words)

Example 2: Say why Good behaviour during mealtimes matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home)

Example 3: Describe one safe action you can take related to Good behaviour during mealtimes this week. (skill: practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone)

Example 4: Name what you can see/touch about “Good behaviour during mealtimes” around your school. (skill: apply Good behaviour during mealtimes in a real Kenyan situation)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Good behaviour during mealtimes to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words.
3. Practise this skill: give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home.
4. Practise this skill: practise Good behaviour during mealtimes step by step until you can do it alone.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Good behaviour during mealtimes from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Good behaviour during mealtimes: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Good behaviour during mealtimes?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. why it is important to mealtimes?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Good behaviour during mealtimes means in simple words.
5. Be able to: give correct examples of Good behaviour during mealtimes from school or home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
